mcqs.question:
With reference to RAKSHA, the 10-year Defence Diplomacy Action Document released in September 2026, consider the following statements:
1. RAKSHA was released by Rajnath Singh on September 3, 2026.
2. RAKSHA is a 8-year Defence Diplomacy Action Document.
3. Its maritime-security framework is linked to DAP-2015.
mcqs.explanation: Statement 1 is correct: RAKSHA was released by Rajnath Singh on September 3, 2026. Statement 2 is incorrect because RAKSHA is a 10-year document, while Statement 3 is incorrect because the relevant framework is DAP-2020, not DAP-2015.

mcqs.question:
Match the following defence organisations with the corresponding details:

List-I
(a) HAL
(b) BDL
(c) DRDO
(d) IAF

List-II
(i) Established on January 1, 1958
(ii) Established in 1940 at Bengaluru
(iii) Established on October 8, 1932
(iv) Established in 1970 at Hyderabad

Codes:
(a) (b) (c) (d)
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are HAL–1940 at Bengaluru, BDL–1970 at Hyderabad, DRDO–January 1, 1958, and IAF–October 8, 1932. Therefore, the correct code is a-ii, b-iv, c-i, d-iii; the other codes interchange the organisations’ establishment details.
